name: Spaceship part
text: By expending your Great Engineer, you have made remarkable progress on the construction of a critical component for the interstellar vessel. The assembly halls roar with the cacophony of industry — technicians welding titanium seams, laborers hauling reinforced plating, and the engineer's voice cutting through the din like a conductor orchestrating a symphony of human ambition. Which module shall receive the final calibrations?

name: Archaeological Dig
text: Beneath the sun-scorched earth, your archaeologists have brushed away millennia of sediment to reveal the faint outline of something extraordinary — an artifact of a civilization long consigned to dust and memory. The lead excavator's hands tremble as the contours of a buried relic emerge from the soil. The find is genuine, and its implications are profound.

name: Archaeological Dig - Hidden - Great Work of Writing
text: Your Archaeological Dig has uncovered a cache of remarkably preserved tablets and scrolls, their ink still legible after centuries entombed in dry earth. The texts appear to be a lost literary masterpiece — a work of such eloquence and philosophical depth that scholars are already weeping at its prose.

name: Archaeological Dig - Hidden - Culture
text: Your Archaeological Dig has unearthed not merely objects, but an entire worldview. The frescoes, pottery, and inscriptions collectively paint a portrait of a society so vibrant and sophisticated that their rediscovery sends shockwaves through our intellectual establishment. A cultural renaissance beckons.

choices.text: Let the past illuminate our future — declare a cultural renaissance

name: Archaeological Dig - Destroy Unit
text: The excavation has collapsed. Tons of earth and stone have swallowed the dig site whole, burying equipment, findings, and the archaeologists themselves beneath an unforgiving mass of rubble. There are no survivors.

name: Reformation
text: A theological earthquake has fractured the bedrock of faith across the known world. The faithful clamor for reform — for a purification of doctrine, a return to spiritual essentials, or a radical reinterpretation of the divine covenant. As a civilization of profound religious conviction, your nation must choose which reformist vision shall become your spiritual compass.
